title: Bug
description: One bug, one file: qa/<app>/bugs/<ID>.json. Written by the bug-report skill.

id.description: Short app prefix and a number, e.g. AL-1. Same as the file name.

area.description: Feature area, e.g. approvals, balance, permissions.

summary.description: Two or three sentences a non-programmer understands: what is wrong and who it hurts.

text.description: What should happen, taken from the requirement (not from what the app does now). For money and dates, the hand-worked value.

link.description: URL or repo path to the requirement, e.g. apps/local/acme-leave/docs/prd.md#us-3-decide

where.description: Where the cause is, if known from the source. Leave out if not known.

how.description: Confirmed two ways: what the app answered, and what is stored.

response.description: The UI or API response that shows the bug.

state.description: The stored state, from the API or a read-only DB query, that shows the bug.

byDesignCheck.description: Who was asked whether this is by design, when, and the answer.

hint.description: A short hint for the fix prompt: what to change.

prd.description: The story or PRD section, e.g. US-3 Decide.

spec.description: Path of the regression spec that states the correct behaviour.

video.description: Path of the captioned clip, qa/<app>/videos/<ID>-<slug>.webm

videoAfter.description: Optional clip of the same steps on a fix branch.

environment.description: local, dev, staging or prod, plus the commit tested.

run.description: The run id that found it.
